summary_paragraph: A woman with a history of gastroparesis and a J-tube presented with a week-long episode of nausea and vomiting, consistent with a gastroparesis flare after years of good control. She was admitted for symptom management, during which she developed mild leukocytosis and transient diarrhea, but remained afebrile with no signs of infection. Imaging confirmed the J-tube was in place and functioning. She was treated with IV fluids, anti-nausea medications, and gradual advancement of diet. Her symptoms resolved, acidosis corrected, and she tolerated a regular diet. She was discharged home in stable condition with instructions to continue home medications, follow a low-fat diet, and follow up with her PCP to monitor white blood cell count.
